description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus PAQ8 level 10 instead of level 11. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: PAQ8 level 11 is the binding resident-memory source in the cmix21 text-mode profile; lowering it one level may bring RAM under the Hutter ceiling while preserving enough archive margin to remain below 10.95 percent at full scale.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Unmeasured. This is the current best Hutter-admissibility profile to test because it targets the measured resident-memory bottleneck.
